```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

results_dir <- params$results_dir

include_figure <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) knitr::include_graphics(path)
}

read_table <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Summary

**Dataset:** `r params$dataset`  
**Cancer types:** `r paste(params$cancer_types, collapse = ", ")`  
**Modalities:** `r paste(params$modalities, collapse = ", ")`  
**Feature-selection methods:** `r paste(params$feature_methods, collapse = ", ")`  
**Clustering methods:** `r paste(params$clustering_methods, collapse = ", ")`  
**Selected feature-selection method:** `r params$best_fs`  
**Selected clustering method:** `r params$best_cm`

## Clustering performance

```{r}
include_figure(file.path(results_dir, "figures", "clustering_summary.png"))
```

## Ranking of combinations

```{r}
ranked <- read_table(file.path(results_dir, "summary", "ranked_clustering_combinations.csv"))

if (!is.null(ranked)) {
  knitr::kable(ranked)
}
```

## Metrics of best combination

```{r}
include_figure(file.path(results_dir, "figures", "best_combination_metrics.png"))
```

## Selected number of clusters

```{r}
include_figure(file.path(results_dir, "figures", "best_k.png"))
```

## Cluster sizes

```{r}
cluster_size_files <- list.files(
  file.path(results_dir, "figures"),
  pattern = "cluster.*size.*\\.png$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(cluster_size_files) > 0) {
  include_figure(cluster_size_files[1])
}
```

## ARI

```{r}
include_figure(file.path(results_dir, "figures", "ARI.png"))
```

## Clinical associations

```{r}
include_figure(file.path(results_dir, "figures", "clinical_associations.png"))
```

## Survival analysis

```{r}
include_figure(file.path(results_dir, "figures", "survival_summary.png"))
```

## Output files

The complete output files for this analysis are available in:

`r results_dir`

Detailed `cola` reports are stored under the `reports/` directory.
